title: 给, 送, 教 + person + thing
summary: Lets you say who gets what, as in 我送他一本书.
structure: Subject + 给 / 送 / 教 / 告诉 + Person + Thing
explanation:
Some verbs take two objects: first the person, then the thing. 他给我一个苹果 'He gives me an apple', 我送她一本书 'I give her a book (as a present)', 王老师教我们汉语 'Teacher Wang teaches us Chinese', 告诉我你的名字 'Tell me your name.'

The person always comes first, right after the verb, then the thing. Don't put a 'to' word in between.

examples.en: I'm giving her a book as a present.

examples.zh: 生日的时候，爸爸送了我一块手表。
examples.en: On my birthday, Dad gave me a watch.

mistakes.why: The person comes before the thing.

exercises.en: My friend gave me a book.

why: 说话 means 'talk' and doesn't take a person and a thing.
The person comes before what is taught.
教 must come before the person.

exercises.instruction: Say who gets it: 妹妹.
why: The person goes before the thing.
This makes 妹妹 the one who gave it.
Correct: 给 + person + thing, no extra word.
对 isn't used after 给 here.

exercises.prompt: Which means 'He taught me to swim'?
why: Don't put 给我 at the end; 教我 is enough.
The verb comes before the person.
